International Aluminium Institute (2021). Aluminium Sector Greenhouse Gas Pathways to 2050. London: IAI, March 2021. https://international-aluminium.org/resource/aluminium-sector-greenhouse-gas-pathways-to-2050-2021

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. 24-page sector scenario brochure (printed pages 1-20; PDF page = printed + 3). It prints NO per-technology energy intensity, cost or emission factor for inert anodes, MVR, electric/hydrogen calcination or CCS in smelting: these are named qualitatively only (p.13-15). to-get.csv wanted smelter energy intensities; the report only cites the IAI online statistics for them (IAI 2020c smelting energy intensity; IAI 2020e alumina refining energy intensity), which are the place to get those numbers. Numbers it does print (all sector-level): 2018 sector emissions by process and source, Mt CO2e (Fig. 1, p.3: alumina refining 204, of which thermal energy 124.3; electrolysis 824, of which electricity 670.6, process CO2 92.6, non-CO2 35.4; anode production 32; casting 6; recycling 19; semis 29; scrap remelting 11; total 1,127); ~5.5 t bauxite per t Al (p.4); primary Al footprint <5 to >25 t CO2e/t depending on power source (p.4); PFCs 35 Mt CO2e in 2018 vs 100 Mt in 1990 (p.13); CO2 concentration in smelter cell off-gas 500-15,000 ppm, the key barrier for capture on potlines (p.13; relevant to electrolysis-cell_prebaked-anode_ccs-diffuse); inert anodes mitigate sources worth ~15% of sector emissions and must match carbon-anode energy intensity (p.13-14); Pathway 2 (Fig. 11, p.14): of 0.65 Gt CO2e BAU 2050 direct emissions, CCUS -35% (-0.5 Gt), inert anodes -15% (-0.2 Gt), refinery and casthouse electrification/fuel switching -15% (-0.2 Gt) (sector shares, not per-plant reduction potentials); CCUS on power plants USD 40-80/t CO2 reprinted from IEA 2019 (p.11); electricity decarbonisation capex USD 0.5-1.5 trillion over 30 years (p.10); scrap processing and melting losses 3% and 6% (p.16); primary production GHG ~25 times recycled (p.17); B2DS 2050 targets 1.5 t CO2e/t semis and 2.5 t CO2e/t primary (p.9). Scope note: global, IAI member data; B2DS (IEA ETP 2017) framework.
